scripts.ios:restart: npm run prebuild -w @honeydo/mobile && npm run ios -w @honeydo/mobile
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @honeydo/shared && npm run typecheck -w @honeydo/api
scripts.test: npm run test -w @honeydo/shared && npm run test -w @honeydo/api
scripts.gate: npm run build:shared && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build:api
